Glad General Trading is a South Sudanese multipurpose company established in 2013, providing general trading, construction, general supply, and clearance and forwarding services.

The company delivers practical, reliable, and cost-effective solutions to businesses, institutions, and organizations. Our services are guided by professionalism, integrity, operational efficiency, and a commitment to meeting client requirements.

Based in Kator, Tombura Road (Abayilif), Juba, South Sudan, Glad General Trading focuses on strengthening long-term business relationships while supporting commercial activities and development initiatives across the country.
Kator, Tombura Road (Abayilif), Juba, South Sudan
To grow our service capabilities, uphold ethical business standards, create employment opportunities, and contribute to South Sudan’s development.
To build sustainable client relationships through professional service, timely execution, and consistent quality.
A South Sudanese multipurpose company delivering general trading, construction, general supply, and clearance & forwarding solutions since 2013.
To provide reliable trading, construction, supply, and clearance and forwarding solutions that meet client needs and create lasting value.
To achieve 100% customer satisfaction by delivering quality products & services at an affordable cost.

items.title: MATHOK ANEI
items.subtitle: Co-founder
items.description:
As Co-Founder and Managing Director of Glad General Trading, Mathok Anei provides strategic leadership and oversees the company's overall direction, business development, and operations. With a commitment to excellence, integrity, and sustainable growth, he plays a central role in strengthening client relationships, identifying business opportunities, and guiding the company's activities across general trading, construction, general supply, and clearance and forwarding.
Mathok Anei is dedicated to building Glad General Trading into a trusted and competitive multipurpose company in South Sudan through professionalism, innovation, and quality service delivery.

items.title: ABTAB
items.subtitle: Co-founder
items.description:
As Co-Founder and Operations Director of Glad General Trading, Abtab plays a key role in coordinating the company's daily operations, project implementation, procurement activities, and service delivery.

With a strong focus on operational efficiency, teamwork, and customer satisfaction, he contributes to ensuring that projects are executed effectively, resources are managed responsibly, and client expectations are met.

Abtab remains committed to supporting the company's long-term vision of providing reliable business solutions while contributing to economic growth and development in South Sudan.

items.title: General Trading
items.subtitle: Quality Products. Reliable Supply. Trusted Partnerships
items.description: We provide dependable sourcing, procurement, trading, and distribution solutions tailored to the needs of businesses, institutions, and organizations across South Sudan.

items.title: Construction
items.subtitle: Building with Excellence. Delivering with Integrity.
items.description: Glad General Trading provides construction and project support solutions, focusing on quality workmanship, reliable materials, efficient project coordination, and client satisfaction. We are committed to delivering practical, durable, and cost-effective solutions that support infrastructure development in South Sudan.

items.title: General Supply
items.subtitle: Quality Assured. Reliability Delivered.
items.description: Glad General Trading offers comprehensive procurement and general supply solutions for businesses, institutions, organizations, and development projects across South Sudan. We focus on sourcing quality materials, equipment, and essential goods while ensuring competitive pricing, dependable service, and timely delivery tailored to each client's requirements.

items.title: Clearance & Forwarding
items.subtitle: Simplifying Logistics. Delivering Beyond Borders
items.description: Glad General Trading provides clearance and forwarding solutions designed to facilitate the smooth movement of goods across borders. Our services include customs documentation support, cargo coordination, import and export logistics, shipment tracking, and transportation arrangements. We focus on efficiency, regulatory compliance, and dependable delivery to help businesses move their goods with confidence.
